const GLYPH=6, PITCH=22, COLS=73, ICOLS=68, XL=99, XI=127.8, XR=538.2;
const RED='#c00000';
const clone=o=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o));
const isAl=c=>/[A-Za-z0-9]/.test(c||'');
const isDg=c=>/[0-9]/.test(c||'');
const same=(a,b)=>!!a.b===!!b.b&&!!a.u===!!b.u&&!!a.s===!!b.s&&!!a.r===!!b.r;

function tokenize(p){
  const chars=[]; for(const r of p.runs) for(const c of r.t) chars.push({c,b:!!r.b,u:!!r.u,s:!!r.s,r:!!r.r});
  const toks=[]; let cur=[],gap=[];
  for(let i=0;i<chars.length;i++){
    const ch=chars[i];
    if(ch.c===' '){ if(cur.length){toks.push({gap,cells:cur});cur=[];gap=[];} gap.push(ch); continue;}
    cur.push(ch);
    const nx=chars[i+1]&&chars[i+1].c, pv=chars[i-1]&&chars[i-1].c;
    if(ch.c==='-'&&isAl(pv)&&isAl(nx)&&!(isDg(pv)&&isDg(nx))){toks.push({gap,cells:cur});cur=[];gap=[];}
  }
  if(cur.length)toks.push({gap,cells:cur});
  if(toks.length)toks[0].gap=[];
  return toks;
}
function wrapPara(p){
  const toks=tokenize(p), lines=[]; if(!toks.length) return lines;
  const st=p.style||'indent';
  const colsFor=n=>n===0?(st==='indent'?ICOLS:COLS):(st==='hang'?ICOLS:COLS);
  const xFor=n=>n===0?(st==='indent'?XI:XL):(st==='hang'?XI:XL);
  let cur=[],len=0;
  const flush=last=>{const n=lines.length;lines.push({toks:cur,len,last,cols:colsFor(n),x:xFor(n)});cur=[];len=0;};
  for(const t of toks){
    const add=(cur.length?t.gap.length:0)+t.cells.length;
    if(cur.length&&len+add>colsFor(lines.length)) flush(false);
    len+=(cur.length?t.gap.length:0)+t.cells.length; cur.push(t);
  }
  flush(true);
  return lines;
}

  if(!L.last && slots.length && L.len<L.cols){extra=L.cols-L.len; per=Math.floor(extra/slots.length); rem=extra%slots.length;}
  const cells=[]; let si=0;

/* ---------- editor <-> model ---------- */
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const ed=$('editor'), prev=$('preview');
let model=null, original=null, curSample='lb';
function isRedColor(c){
  if(!c) return false; c=c.trim().toLowerCase(); if(c==='red') return true;
  let m=c.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{6})$/), r,g,b;
  if(m){r=parseInt(m[1].slice(0,2),16);g=parseInt(m[1].slice(2,4),16);b=parseInt(m[1].slice(4,6),16);}
  else{m=c.match(/rgba?\(\s*(\d+)[ ,]+(\d+)[ ,]+(\d+)/); if(!m) return false; r=+m[1];g=+m[2];b=+m[3];}

function walk(n,st,runs){

}
function domToModel(){
  const paras=[];
  ed.childNodes.forEach(n=>{
    const runs=[]; walk(n,{b:false,u:false,s:false,r:false},runs);
    const mr=mergeRuns(runs); if(!mr.length||!mr.some(r=>r.t.trim()))return;

function modelToDom(){
  ed.textContent='';

    const d=document.createElement('div'); d.dataset.pstyle=p.style||'indent';
    for(const r of p.runs){
      let el=document.createTextNode(r.t);
      const wrap=tag=>{const w=document.createElement(tag);w.appendChild(el);el=w;};
      if(r.b)wrap('b'); if(r.u)wrap('u'); if(r.s)wrap('s');
      if(r.r){const w=document.createElement('font');w.setAttribute('color',RED);w.appendChild(el);el=w;}

    }

  }

}
/* ---------- preview ---------- */
function span(parent,runs){
  for(const r of runs){
    const e=document.createElement('span'); e.textContent=r.t;
    const cl=[]; if(r.b)cl.push('b'); if(r.u)cl.push('u'); if(r.s)cl.push('s'); if(r.r)cl.push('r');
    e.className=cl.join(' '); parent.appendChild(e);
  }
}
function renderPreview(){
  const pages=layout(model);
  const avail=Math.max(260,prev.clientWidth-28), scale=Math.min(1.25,avail/816);
  prev.textContent='';
  for(const pg of pages){
    const box=document.createElement('div'); box.className='pagebox'; box.style.width=(816*scale)+'px'; box.style.height=(1056*scale)+'px';
    const pe=document.createElement('div'); pe.className='page'; pe.style.transform=`scale(${scale})`;
    for(const it of pageItems(model,pg)){
      const e=document.createElement('div'); e.className='t'; e.style.left=it.x+'pt'; e.style.top=(it.top+0.064*it.size)+'pt';
      e.style.fontSize=it.size+'pt'; e.style.lineHeight=it.size+'pt';
      if(it.runs) span(e,it.runs); else {e.textContent=it.t; if(it.bold)e.style.fontWeight='700';}
      pe.appendChild(e);
    }
    box.appendChild(pe); prev.appendChild(box);
  }
  const lines=pages.reduce((a,p)=>a+p.lines.length,0);
  let red=0; for(const p of model.paras) for(const r of p.runs) if(r.r) red+=r.t.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  $('stat').textContent=`${pages.length} page${pages.length>1?'s':''} · ${lines} lines · ${red} red word${red===1?'':'s'}`;
  $('proofH').textContent=`Proof (${model.layout.firstN} lines on page 1, then ${model.layout.perPage} per page)`;
}
let tm=null; function schedule(){clearTimeout(tm);tm=setTimeout(()=>{domToModel();renderPreview();},120);}
ed.addEventListener('input',schedule);
ed.addEventListener('paste',e=>{e.preventDefault();const t=(e.clipboardData||window.clipboardData).getData('text/plain').replace(/\s*[\r\n]+\s*/g,' ');document.execCommand('insertText',false,t);});
/* header / page 1 setup */
function renderSetup(){
  const box=$('setup'); box.textContent='';
  const lab=(txt,el)=>{const l=document.createElement('label');l.append(txt,el);box.appendChild(l);};
  const ta=document.createElement('textarea'); ta.rows=Math.max(2,model.running.length); ta.value=model.running.join('\n');
  ta.addEventListener('input',()=>{model.running=ta.value.split('\n').map(s=>s.replace(/\s+$/,'')).filter(Boolean);renderPreview();});
  lab('Running header (top of every page, one line each)',ta);
  model.front.forEach((f,i)=>{const inp=document.createElement('input');inp.value=f.t;inp.addEventListener('input',()=>{f.t=inp.value;renderPreview();});lab(`Page 1 line ${i+1}${f.size>10?' (large)':''}`,inp);});
  const n=document.createElement('input');n.type='number';n.min=1;n.max=31;n.value=model.layout.firstN;
  n.addEventListener('input',()=>{const v=Math.max(1,Math.min(31,parseInt(n.value)||1));model.layout.firstN=v;renderPreview();});
  lab('Numbered lines on page 1',n);
}
/* toolbar */
document.querySelectorAll('.bar button').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>e.preventDefault()));
$('bBold').onclick=()=>{document.execCommand('bold');schedule();};
$('bUl').onclick=()=>{document.execCommand('underline');schedule();};
const strike=()=>{document.execCommand('strikeThrough');schedule();};
$('bStr').onclick=strike;
ed.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&e.shiftKey&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='x'){e.preventDefault();strike();}});
$('bRed').onclick=()=>{
  ed.focus(); const cur=document.queryCommandValue('foreColor');
  document.execCommand('styleWithCSS',false,false);
  document.execCommand('foreColor',false,isRedColor(cur)?'#000001':RED); schedule();
};
function curBlock(){const s=getSelection(); let n=s.anchorNode; while(n&&n.parentNode!==ed) n=n.parentNode; return n&&n.nodeType===1?n:null;}
$('pstyle').addEventListener('change',e=>{const b=curBlock(); if(b){b.dataset.pstyle=e.target.value;schedule();} ed.focus();});
document.addEventListener('selectionchange',()=>{const b=curBlock(); if(b) $('pstyle').value=b.dataset.pstyle||'indent';});
$('bClear').onclick=()=>{domToModel();for(const p of model.paras)for(const r of p.runs)r.r=false;modelToDom();renderPreview();};
$('bMark').onclick=()=>{domToModel();markChanges();modelToDom();renderPreview();};
function load(key){importedModel=null;curSample=key;model=clone(SAMPLES[key]);original=clone(SAMPLES[key]);renderSetup();modelToDom();renderPreview();}
$('sampleSel').addEventListener('change',e=>load(e.target.value));
$('bReset').onclick=()=>{if(importedModel){model=clone(importedModel);original=clone(importedModel);renderSetup();modelToDom();renderPreview();}else load($('sampleSel').value);};
function markChanges(){
  const flat=m=>{const W=[];for(const p of m.paras){let cur=[];for(const r of p.runs)for(const c of r.t){if(c===' '){if(cur.length)W.push(cur);cur=[];}else cur.push({c,b:r.b,u:r.u,s:r.s,r:r.r});}if(cur.length)W.push(cur);}return W;};
  const key=w=>w.map(x=>x.c).join('');
  const A=flat(original).map(key);
  const newParas=model.paras.map(p=>({style:p.style,cs:p.runs.flatMap(r=>[...r.t].map(c=>({c,b:r.b,u:r.u,s:r.s,r:r.r})))}));
  const W=[];for(const p of newParas){let cur=[];for(const x of p.cs){if(x.c===' '){if(cur.length)W.push(cur);cur=[];}else cur.push(x);}if(cur.length)W.push(cur);}
  const B=W.map(key), n=A.length, mm=B.length, w=mm+1, dp=new Uint16Array((n+1)*w);
  for(let i=n-1;i>=0;i--)for(let j=mm-1;j>=0;j--)dp[i*w+j]=A[i]===B[j]?dp[(i+1)*w+j+1]+1:Math.max(dp[(i+1)*w+j],dp[i*w+j+1]);

  while(i<n&&j<mm){ if(A[i]===B[j]){keep[j]=true;i++;j++;} else if(dp[(i+1)*w+j]>=dp[i*w+j+1])i++; else j++; }

  for(const p of model.paras){const rs=p.runs;for(let k=1;k<rs.length-1;k++)if(rs[k].t===' '&&rs[k-1].r&&rs[k+1].r)rs[k].r=true;p.runs=mergeRuns(rs);}

/* ---------- PDF import: runs entirely in the browser, nothing is uploaded ---------- */
const PDFJS_URL=new URL('lib/pdf.min.mjs',location.href).href;
const PDFJS_WORKER=new URL('lib/pdf.worker.min.mjs',location.href).href;
const IMP_SCALE=4;
let pdfjsPromise=null, importedModel=null;
function getPdfjs(){
  if(!pdfjsPromise) pdfjsPromise=import(PDFJS_URL).then(m=>{m.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc=PDFJS_WORKER;return m;});
  return pdfjsPromise;
}
/* underline / strike-through / red are read from the rendered page pixels */
function makeFlagReader(img){
  const W=img.width, Hh=img.height, d=img.data, S=IMP_SCALE;
  const ink=(px,py)=>{
    if(px<0||py<0||px>=W||py>=Hh) return 0;
    const i=(py*W+px)*4, r=d[i], g=d[i+1], b=d[i+2];
    if(d[i+3]<128) return 0;
    if(r>140&&g<90&&b<90) return 2;
    return (r+g+b)/3<170?1:0;
  };
  const cover=(x0,x1,y0,y1)=>{
    const a=Math.round(x0*S), b=Math.round(x1*S), c=Math.round(y0*S), e=Math.max(c+1,Math.round(y1*S));
    let best=0;
    for(let py=c;py<e;py++){let n=0;for(let px=a;px<b;px++) if(ink(px,py)) n++; best=Math.max(best,n/Math.max(1,b-a));}
    return best;
  };
  return (x,base)=>{
    const a=x+0.3, b=x+GLYPH-0.3;
    let red=0; const ra=Math.round(x*S), rb=Math.round((x+GLYPH)*S), rc=Math.round((base-8)*S), re=Math.round((base+2)*S);
    for(let py=rc;py<re;py++) for(let px=ra;px<rb;px++) if(ink(px,py)===2) red++;
    return {u:cover(a,b,base+0.05,base+1.0)>=0.9, s:cover(a,b,base-4.6,base-1.8)>=0.9, r:red>=4};

/* place characters into monospace columns (relative to the first one) */
function placeText(chars){
  chars=chars.slice().sort((p,q)=>p.x-q.x);
  const x0=chars[0].x, map=new Map(); let maxc=0;
  for(const c of chars){const col=Math.round((c.x-x0)/GLYPH); if(!map.has(col)||map.get(col).ch===' ') map.set(col,c); maxc=Math.max(maxc,col);}

  while(cells.length&&cells[cells.length-1].c===' ') cells.pop();
  return {cells,x0,x1:x0+cells.length*GLYPH};

/* letters like e and m have a full-width bar at strike height, so only a run of 4+ cells counts as a strike-through */
function dropShortRuns(cells,key,min){
  for(let i=0;i<cells.length;){
    if(!cells[i][key]){i++;continue;}
    let j=i; while(j<cells.length&&cells[j][key]) j++;

function readPage(chars,flagAt){
  chars=chars.filter(c=>c.ch!==''&&c.ch!=='\u0000').sort((p,q)=>p.base-q.base||p.x-q.x);
  const rows=[];
  for(const c of chars){const r=rows[rows.length-1]; if(r&&Math.abs(c.base-r.base)<2) r.chars.push(c); else rows.push({base:c.base,chars:[c]});}
  const out={marks:[],body:[],head:[],front:[]};
  for(const row of rows){
    const lead=row.chars.filter(c=>c.x<92), rest=row.chars.filter(c=>c.x>=92&&c.ch.trim());
    if(lead.length&&lead.every(c=>/\d/.test(c.ch))){
      out.marks.push({n:+lead.map(c=>c.ch).join(''),base:row.base});
      if(rest.length){
        const pt=placeText(row.chars.filter(c=>c.x>=92));
        for(const cell of pt.cells){const f=flagAt(cell.x,row.base); cell.u=f.u; cell.s=f.s; cell.r=f.r;}
        dropShortRuns(pt.cells,'s',4);

      }
      continue;
    }
    const top=row.base-8;
    if(top<52){const left=row.chars.filter(c=>c.x<300&&c.ch.trim()); if(left.length) out.head.push(placeText(row.chars.filter(c=>c.x<300)).cells.map(c=>c.c).join('')); continue;}
    const pt=placeText(row.chars); if(!pt.cells.length) continue;

function assembleModel(pgs){
  const p1=pgs[0];
  if(!p1||!p1.marks.length) throw new Error('No numbered lines found. This does not look like a Nebraska bill or amendment PDF.');
  const r1=v=>Math.round(v*10)/10, firstBase=p1.marks[0].base;
  const later=pgs.slice(1).filter(p=>p.marks.length);
  const layout={firstTop:r1(firstBase-8), firstN:p1.marks.length,
    bodyTop:later.length?r1(later[0].marks[0].base-8):r1(firstBase-8),
    perPage:later.length?Math.max(...later.map(p=>p.marks.length)):31};
  const running=p1.head.map(s=>s.replace(/\s+$/,'')).filter(Boolean);
  const front=p1.front.filter(f=>f.base<firstBase-2).map(f=>{
    const o={t:f.t,top:r1(f.base-0.8*f.size),size:f.size,bold:f.bold}, ctr=(f.x0+f.x1)/2;
    if(f.x0>XL+6&&Math.abs(ctr-305)<10) o.cx=r1(ctr); else o.x=r1(f.x0);
    return o;
  });
  const lines=pgs.flatMap(p=>p.body), paras=[]; let cur=null, ended=true;
  for(const L of lines){
    const newIndent=cur&&!ended&&cur.lines[0].x0>XL+8&&L.x0>XL+8;
    if(!cur||ended||newIndent){cur={lines:[L]};paras.push(cur);} else cur.lines.push(L);
    ended=L.x1<534;
  }
  const out=paras.map(P=>{
    const f=P.lines[0], s=P.lines[1];
    const style=f.x0>XL+8?'indent':(s&&s.x0>XL+8?'hang':'flush');
    let ch=[];
    P.lines.forEach((L,i)=>{
      if(i>0){const pv=ch[ch.length-1]; if(!(pv&&pv.c==='-')){const n=L.cells[0]; ch.push({c:' ',b:false,u:pv.u&&n.u,s:pv.s&&n.s,r:pv.r&&n.r});}}
      for(const c of L.cells) ch.push(c);
    });
    const fin=[];
    for(const c of ch){if(c.c===' '){const l=fin[fin.length-1]; if(!l||l.c===' ') continue;} fin.push(c);}
    while(fin.length&&fin[fin.length-1].c===' ') fin.pop();
    fin.forEach((c,i)=>{if(c.c===' '){const p=fin[i-1],n=fin[i+1]; c.b=!!(p&&p.b&&n&&n.b); if(p&&n&&p.r&&n.r) c.r=true;}});
    return {style,runs:mergeRuns(fin.map(c=>({t:c.c,b:c.b,u:c.u,s:c.s,r:c.r})))};
  }).filter(p=>p.runs.length);
  if(!out.length) throw new Error('No body text found.');
  return {layout,running,front,paras:out};
}
async function pdfToModel(buf){
  const pdfjs=await getPdfjs();
  const pdf=await pdfjs.getDocument({data:new Uint8Array(buf)}).promise;
  const pgs=[];
  for(let n=1;n<=pdf.numPages;n++){
    $('stat').textContent='Reading page '+n+' of '+pdf.numPages+'…';
    const page=await pdf.getPage(n), H=page.getViewport({scale:1}).height, vp=page.getViewport({scale:IMP_SCALE});
    const cv=document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width=Math.ceil(vp.width); cv.height=Math.ceil(vp.height);
    const ctx=cv.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);
    await page.render({canvasContext:ctx,viewport:vp}).promise;
    const flagAt=makeFlagReader(ctx.getImageData(0,0,cv.width,cv.height));
    const tc=await page.getTextContent(), chars=[];
    for(const it of tc.items){
      if(!it.str||!it.transform) continue;
      let name=''; try{name=page.commonObjs.get(it.fontName).name||'';}catch(e){}
      if(!name&&tc.styles[it.fontName]) name=tc.styles[it.fontName].fontFamily||'';
      const bold=/bold|black|heavy/i.test(name), size=Math.hypot(it.transform[0],it.transform[1])||10, cw=it.width/it.str.length;
      for(let i=0;i<it.str.length;i++) chars.push({ch:it.str[i],x:it.transform[4]+i*cw,base:H-it.transform[5],size,bold});
    }
    pgs.push(readPage(chars,flagAt));
    cv.width=cv.height=0; page.cleanup();
  }
  return assembleModel(pgs);
}
async function importPdf(file){
  const st=$('stat');
  try{
    const m=await pdfToModel(await file.arrayBuffer());
    importedModel=clone(m); model=m; original=clone(m);
    renderSetup(); modelToDom(); renderPreview();
    st.textContent='Opened '+file.name+' ('+m.paras.length+' paragraphs). Check it against the PDF before editing.';
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err); st.textContent='Could not read that PDF: '+(err&&err.message?err.message:err);
  }
}
$('bImport').onclick=()=>$('pdfIn').click();
$('pdfIn').onchange=e=>{const f=e.target.files[0]; e.target.value=''; if(f) importPdf(f);};
document.addEventListener('dragover',e=>{if(e.dataTransfer&&[...e.dataTransfer.types].includes('Files')) e.preventDefault();},true);
document.addEventListener('drop',e=>{const f=e.dataTransfer&&[...e.dataTransfer.files].find(x=>/\.pdf$/i.test(x.name)); if(f){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();importPdf(f);}},true);
/* files */
async function saveFile(name,data){
  const isPdf=/\.pdf$/i.test(name), type=isPdf?'application/pdf':'application/json';
  if(window.showSaveFilePicker){
    try{
      const fh=await showSaveFilePicker({suggestedName:name,types:[{description:isPdf?'PDF':'Draft',accept:{[type]:[isPdf?'.pdf':'.json']}}]});
      const w=await fh.createWritable(); await w.write(new Blob([data],{type})); await w.close(); return;
    }catch(e){ if(e&&e.name==='AbortError') return; }
  }
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data],{type}));
  const a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=url; a.download=name; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
  setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),10000);
}
const docName=()=>(model.running[0]||'bill').replace(/[^\w.-]+/g,'_');
$('bPdf').onclick=async()=>{domToModel();saveFile(docName()+'.pdf',await buildPDF(model));};
$('bSaveJson').onclick=()=>{domToModel();saveFile(docName()+'-draft.json',JSON.stringify({model,original},null,1));};
$('bOpen').onclick=()=>$('fileIn').click();
$('fileIn').onchange=e=>{const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;const rd=new FileReader();rd.onload=()=>{try{const o=JSON.parse(rd.result);if(!o.model||!o.model.paras)throw 0;model=o.model;original=o.original||clone(model);renderSetup();modelToDom();renderPreview();}catch(err){$('stat').textContent='That file is not a saved draft.';}};rd.readAsText(f);e.target.value='';};
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{clearTimeout(tm);tm=setTimeout(renderPreview,150);});
load('lb');
window.__bill={layout,buildPDF,load,get model(){return model;},set model(m){model=m;}};
